tone.target: warm clean-to-edge blues rock with tight pick attack
tone.profile: warm clean-to-edge blues rock with tight pick attack
tone.summary: A warm, articulate signal chain using a mild boost and classic Fender-style amp simulation (US Deluxe) to achieve clear mids and subtle tube breakup, complemented by spring reverb and delay.

blocks.purpose: Provide light, natural crunch and grit without heavy fuzz or high gain.

alternatives.reason: Also viable, but Green OD often provides a slightly more open/vintage sound.
